cell_case_summary_method: attribution context, unsupported_q_obs; in E/E_scope improved, where Q_obs = T is correct (`correct_here` true), the cell instead carries correct_acceptance (`metric` says which) and no zero-event bound. equal_case_mean = mean over cases of the case's mean over scored repeats; ci95_case_t = t interval over case means (df = cases - 1), clipped to [0, 1], descriptive and anti-conservative near 0/1; degenerate = every case has the same mean (zero width is not precision). zero_event_upper_case = exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound over cases, 1 - 0.05**(1/cases), given only when no case has an event (null otherwise); it treats cases as exchangeable draws from the builder's case population. scheduled / cases_scheduled from manifest.json.

posthoc_lenient_recommendation.label: POST-HOC SENSITIVITY, not the frozen scorer (SCORING_SPEC: no lenient mapping). Rule: when the strict scorer finds no valid recommendation in the first JSON object of a scored attribution response, take the last '"recommendation": "<approve|request_more_evidence|reject>"' in the full response text (recovers a recommendation placed after a stray closing brace). Claims are never re-scored.

zero_event_bounds.label: Per cell, unsupported Q_obs. Headline = upper95_cases: exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound over cases, events counted as cases with >= 1 event in their repeats (1 - 0.05**(1/K) at zero; rule of three ~ 3/K). It treats cases as exchangeable draws from the builder's case population; the cases are builder-written, not a random sample. upper95_trials ASSUMES INDEPENDENT TRIALS (repeats are nested in cases), reference only.

reasons_when_marked_established.R_reason: The 2026 audit record confirms the site passed its biomass-boiler emissions inspection.

reasons_when_marked_established.R_reason: The audit record confirms that Wickerslade Breeder Farm passed its 2026 biomass-boiler emissions inspection.

reasons_when_marked_established.P_reason: The audit record from Brantwood Poultry Audit Services verifies the site's compliance with the stated male-to-female ratio throughout 2025.

reasons_when_marked_established.R_reason: The audit record confirms that Wickerslade Breeder Farm passed its 2026 emissions inspection, which is an independently verified fact.

reasons_when_marked_established.R_reason: The 2026 emergency-lighting inspection is confirmed by the audit record, which verifies the site passed on 9 February 2026.
